snippet_primary: "I purchased items from a seller that were delivered well beyond the expected delivery time. When they arrived they were damaged due to poor packaging. I contacted seller who said they would refund and then they ghosted me. I got Etsy involved and Etsy cancelled the order and refunded me but also covered the sellers cost. Now I am unable to leave a review on the sellers account? Even though I went three months waiting for this item that was for a wedding. I think that is crazy that future buyers won't be able to see accurate reviews on the seller"
